headline: Hidalgo County Power Backup Report
summary: Homes in Hidalgo County face a moderate risk. Records from the past 8 years show a long outage about once every 8 years. In February 2021, 16% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 78 hours. In July 2020, 20% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 24 hours. One Core lasts about 36 hours in February. Two Cores last about 26 hours in June. Two Cores cover 79% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
